name: catch_up
retrieval: chronological current-meeting segments; relevant project excerpts only when matched
citation: Exact supporting quotations retain source ID/version/hash/time or original file lines. Model synthesis is separately labelled inference with IDs of validated quotations; structural validation is not semantic proof.
abstention: State insufficient evidence when no supported excerpt; do not invent tasks or owners
task_steps: Describe what changed in the current meeting using recent evidence.
Separate agreed decisions from proposals and unresolved questions.
Mention owners and next steps only when stated; do not infer assignments.
